body: Round 1 (51ba5801..42414b6d: the test module and revise.yaml), Verdict: correct; no P0, P1 or P2; no command refused. The reviewer ran the module inside the sandbox (13 tests OK); made a worktree of 725b25bf, where the new test fails by assertion at its path check because the sandbox refuses the untemplated mktemp -d; and with a GNU-style mktemp shim on PATH, which honours TMPDIR without a template, the test still fails at 725b25bf by assertion on the update-agent-assets. prefix, so it is red on both platforms. It cannot pass falsely or crash: a missing calls log gives an empty list (an assertion failure, not FileNotFoundError), the path check pins exactly one entry before outputs[0] is read, and the return code is asserted. ruff format and ruff check are clean; revise.yaml parses and its fields match the a03 record.
Round 1, P3 high: update_omp_in's new tmpdir=None adds TMPDIR only when given, so its existing callers run with the environment they had. No change needed.

Round 1, P3 medium: revise.yaml carries one selector for the round's five findings. Kept: the other four are record defects no test checks, and the owned row asks for one test; the file::name form without a class matches the contract and the module's earlier revise.yaml records (a01, a02), and the named test exists.

Round 1 note (evidence integrity): the worker's draft said the test would pass the old code on Linux, where GNU mktemp honours TMPDIR. The reviewer's GNU-style shim shows it fails there too, on the update-agent-assets. prefix assertion. Fixed in the records commit: report.md and learning.md state that the test is red on both platforms.
